scope: source-only review addendum to frozen producer pending deque v2 prototype
decision: Do not adopt or claim cancellation/unwind safety; await a complete cleanup design, independent review and native testing.

findings.issue: Constructing receiving.drain before VecDeque::extend may reserve can drop accepted records not yet transferred if an allocation or capacity panic unwinds. Pre-reserving alone does not solve the potentially allocating scratch merge in Worker::drop.
The selected Vec push can allocate after removing a record from the pending queue. The same pop/remove-before-push pattern is present in v14; it is not an established new regression.

findings.location: large synchronous transfers and retained scratch
findings.issue: Scratch transfer, large batch or Drop work may be O(n), and scratch can retain peak capacity. No scheduler latency or whole-producer memory bound has been established.

limits: These are conditional source-level unwind/capacity-panic concerns, not observed failures. Many out-of-memory conditions abort rather than unwind.
No native compilation, tests, Kafka run, benchmark or production qualification occurred.
The hosted retained-backing failure phase and cause remain unknown.
